primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

wikipediaRead.title: Zephon (angel)
wikipediaRead.locator: L102–104: the article discusses an angelic Zephon and also mentions/differentiates Zepho son of Eliphaz; it does not establish identity with 1 Chronicles 1:36 “Zephi”.
